_comment: Target bands for batch-harness metrics (docs/match-engine-v2.md). Rates only: sim time is compressed (360s ~ 90min), so totals are not comparable to real matches except where noted. Sources: typical top-flight open-play figures (Opta/StatsBomb/Wyscout public summaries). Bands are deliberately wide first-pass estimates; tighten as calibration progresses.

per_side._note_totals: shots/goals totals dropped as targets: 360s stands for 90 min but players move at real speed, so a match fits ~1/3 of a real match's possessions. Judge per-possession rates; total goals is a game-design question (match length/pace), not an AI one.
